dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interlocking light-gray loops and semi-circles with jagged outer perimeters; gradients transition from a high-intensity perimeter to a dark-gray interior core, primarily concentrated on the posterior lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized light-gray pixel clusters; higher concentration of core high-intensity pixels observed along the dorsal ridge and embedded within the lateral annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral annuli form an obtuse, scalene triangle; a secondary alignment of four high-intensity dorsal blobs forms a slightly curved linear sequence along the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, isolated high-intensity red/orange pixel cluster is visible on the anterior dorsal surface near the head-neck transition.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, fine-lined reticulum pattern connects the larger annuli, creating a puzzle-piece or lattice-like appearance across the dorsal-lateral regions.
